Stream emits error event when a page fails mid-crawl, but other pages succeed

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import crawl_stream, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(max_concurrent=1, max_depth=1, respect_robots_txt=False)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = crawl_stream(engine, url)
    chunks = []
    async for chunk in result:
        chunks.append(chunk)
    print(result.stream.has_page_event)
    print(result.stream.has_error_event)
    print(result.stream.has_complete_event)

asyncio.run(main())
```
